state.background: Review the plan in results/plan46/phase6/chromium-unsplit-efficient-order-plan-2026-09-29.md. The active Chromium runner already executes one aggregate config with 22 files, fileParallelism=false, and maxWorkers=1, then runs WebKit sequentially. The Chromium A/B split was only an external experiment, not the active runner. Its combined Chromium+WebKit time was 494.677s versus 413.093s for single Chromium plus WebKit, and it had six Chromium assertion failures. The plan preserves one Chromium run and WebKit order, changing only the aggregate sequencer order. It sorts the same 22 files by ascending assertion-duration sums from one successful 2026-09-28 Chromium log whose roster matches; the values exclude setup and predate later test changes. This serial shortest-processing-time-first heuristic minimizes average file-result waiting time, not full suite duration. The plan requires only a lightweight config listing/order check, with no full browser suite required for an order-only change.
acceptanceCriteria: The active runner continues to use one aggregate Chromium config and one worker, with WebKit order unchanged.
All 22 active Chromium files appear once in the planned ascending historical-duration order.
The plan accurately limits its performance claim to average file-result waiting time and makes no total-runtime reduction claim.
The historical one-run timing caveat and excluded setup overhead are explicit.
Validation is bounded to checking the effective config and order; unrelated files and existing index state remain unchanged.
verification: Read-only audit of results/plan46/phase5/chromium-webkit-parallel-run-2026-09-28/chromium.log and the archived A/B experiment summary.
No tests were run for the plan review.
knownConstraints: The active runner is already unsplit; the planned implementation changes ordering only.
The per-file timing rank comes from one historical run and may not represent current test cost.
Reordering a serial full run does not change its total runtime absent inter-file cache or state effects.
The working tree contains unrelated staged and unstaged changes; preserve them.

That clarification must present at least two mutually exclusive immediate next actions, changing only one target per choice, and require a case-specific finding, affected file/case or requirement, observed evidence or exact neededEvidence, a concrete nextAction/proposedFix, and remainingUncertainty (explicitly none if none). Preserve the initial decision summary and choice distribution; the clarification effective verdict must remain requires_revalidation and must never upgrade a non-pass to approval. If clarification fails, is invalid, selects outside the listed choices, or lacks required diagnosis detail, preserve the initial result and clarification outcome as unresolved/incomplete, and do not chain another clarification. If the initial request/response fails, is invalid, or unsupported, preserve the initial error behavior and do not clarify. Do not invent details.

plan.instructions: Is the unsplit Chromium, serial shortest-processing-time-first sequencer plan valid for the stated efficiency objective, given the supplied caveats? Return a probability distribution over the mutually exclusive choices.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The plan preserves one Chromium aggregate run and WebKit order, uses the 22-file roster once in the documented historical-duration order, states the actual metric and limitations, and has suitable lightweight validation.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: The stated efficiency objective conflicts with the proposed shortest-processing-time-first ordering; identify the objective and correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Information needed to judge the 22-file order or active runner is missing; identify the exact evidence needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The proposed order or validation boundary is incomplete; identify the precise gap.
criteria.implementation_issue: The plan has a concrete operational defect; identify its location and correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The plan changes more than the active Chromium order or fails to preserve unrelated execution behavior; identify the boundary.
criteria.other: A material concern does not fit another category; identify the concern and fix or exact needed evidence.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied context cannot support a judgment; identify missing context if possible.
